title: [29.x][Expense Agent] Backport approval conversation from #10570
summary: The Expense Agent now supports approval conversations, allowing submitters to add comments when resubmitting reports and exposing the latest approver and submitter comments through the API and report page.
key_points: Submitters can add comments when resubmitting expense reports
Latest approver and submitter comments are exposed via the API and Expense Report page
Comment snapshots are recorded in activity history as immutable records
quote: Adds submitter comments for resubmission, exposes the latest approver and submitter comments through the API and Expense Report page.
